# Component extraction audit

Reproduced all nine retained components from three exact versions using recovered original parser functions, without importing the collector. ONS spans retain the original normalized text and first-match selection, with all competing matches. Four real defects are demonstrated: regional report classified as national; regional payroll0.8% captured as0 persons; national payroll-101000 yearly change labeled monthly; regular earnings assigned3.9% belonging to total earnings (regular growth is3.5% in the retained sentence). Synthetic cases also expose first-match ambiguity, lost negative-rate sign and vacancy percentage captured as count.

The preserved DOL PDF SHA256a09ff781f436b69a753edcf6bcac9556c2dea09d40de1c4191e664b5dc32d518 was copied unchanged, extracted with pypdf6.15.0 and visually inspected on page1. The native parser exactly reproduces all three component dictionaries and reported prior/revision values. Initial claims reference September12; insured unemployment and rate reference September5. Generated summary correctly fails the native document parser. Original HTTP receipt and extraction readiness remain unproved; the current source configuration is frozen metadata, not historical schedule proof.

Checkpoint SHA25669d1f36ec704dbe6e698fa9e0d07c1ebfbb3b4aa2f7950497e79c9b284c6a6e3. Same-implementer source/evidence review only. No forecast inputs admitted, no fits or surprise; prior negative experiment unchanged.

# Offline component guard repair

Implemented a separate subject/unit/period adapter, preserving all original collector code and outputs. The regional ONS report now yields no national cells. The national bundle yields six explicit cells: monthly payroll-19000 for July and-26000 for August (August provisional), regular earnings3.5%, total earnings3.9%, UK unemployment4.9% for May–July, and vacancy change-8000 for June–August against March–May. Annual payroll numbers cannot become monthly values; percentage tokens cannot become counts. Conflicting same-component/same-period values abstain, while distinct months remain distinct cells.

DOL retains the recovered native publication/schedule/arithmetic guards and binds three component weeks to the embedded release under bounded date rules. Initial claims196000 end September12; insured unemployment1730000 and rate1.1 end September5. Decimal derivation records the implied prior rate1.2 separately from the original retained1.2000000000000002. No original vintage/readiness or historical source schedule availability is invented.

Source gate means retained metadata, not independent issuer certification. Narrow unsupported grammar abstains. Source-asof integration remains next; no forecast admission, fit, surprise or historical activation backdating.
